This is the default style: a plain surface with a standard border, no shadow or emphasis. This card has elevation: a soft drop shadow and lighter background make it look raised off the page. This card has a visible border: a bold 2px outline and transparent background, no shadow. This is a minimal, plain style: stripped of border and shadow so only the content shows.
